title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - WateringGun
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/WateringGun. An actuator to irrigate a space. Subclass of saref:Actuator (SAREF core class, not modeled here); inherited saref:Actuator vocabulary (saref:actsUpon, saref:hasState, saref:makesActuation, etc.) is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WateringGun'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

actsUpon.description: Property/Relationship. saref:actsUpon. The s4agri:Property named individual this actuator acts upon: 'the amount of water falling in the soil by irrigation methods'. IRI: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/IrrigationWater.

status.description: Property. saref:hasState (inherited from saref:Actuator). The current actuation state of the watering gun.

isSubSystemOf.description: Relationship. ssn:hasSubSystem (inverse). The WateringSystem this actuator is a component of, if any.
